mapper.select: SELECT w.ward_id, w.ward_nm AS ward_name FROM tb_emp e JOIN tb_ward w ON w.ward_id = e.ward_id AND w.hosp_div_id = e.hosp_div_id WHERE e.hosp_div_id = #{hospitalId} AND e.emp_id = #{userId} AND e.role_cd = 'USER'
SELECT EMP_ID, EMP_PW, HOSP_DIV_ID, WARD_ID, EMP_NM, ROLE_CD, AUTH_ST, CRT_DT, UPD_DT, FAILED_LOGIN_COUNT, LOCKED_UNTIL FROM TB_EMP WHERE HOSP_DIV_ID = #{hospitalId} AND EMP_ID = #{userId}
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_EMP SET EMP_PW = #{passwordHash}, MUST_CHANGE_PASSWORD = FALSE, FAILED_LOGIN_COUNT = 0, LOCKED_UNTIL = NULL, UPD_DT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE EMP_ID = #{userId}

UPDATE TB_EMP SET FAILED_LOGIN_COUNT = CASE WHEN LOCKED_UNTIL IS NOT NULL AND LOCKED_UNTIL <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP THEN 1 ELSE FAILED_LOGIN_COUNT + 1 END, LOCKED_UNTIL = CASE WHEN LOCKED_UNTIL IS NOT NULL AND LOCKED_UNTIL <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP THEN NULL WHEN FAILED_LOGIN_COUNT + 1 >= 5 THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP + INTERVAL '1 minute' ELSE NULL END, UPD_DT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE HOSP_DIV_ID = #{hospitalId} AND EMP_ID = #{userId} AND ( LOCKED_UNTIL IS NULL OR LOCKED_UNTIL <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
